stories.capability: see every profile assigned to me ordered by how much of its window is left, with its blocking reason on the row
stories.benefit: a stalled dependency is visible when I arrive rather than discovered at the deadline

acceptance_criteria.given: I have four profiles assigned and one is waiting on a sponsor input
acceptance_criteria.then: the blocked profile shows a blocking chip naming the outstanding input, and the queue is ordered with the tightest remaining window first

acceptance_criteria.given: a profile's deadline has already passed
acceptance_criteria.when: I view it in the queue
acceptance_criteria.then: its clock reads overdue with the elapsed time, and never a negative remaining value

acceptance_criteria.given: I have no profiles assigned
acceptance_criteria.then: I see an empty state naming what will appear here and offering to start a new profile, visibly different from a filter that matched nothing

accessibility_criteria.given: I navigate the screening queue with a keyboard only
accessibility_criteria.then: focus enters the filter bar, then the summary strip, then each row in visible order, every focused element carries a visible focus ring, and the row's blocking reason is reachable without a pointer

accessibility_criteria.given: I use a screen reader and change a queue filter
accessibility_criteria.then: a polite live region announces the resulting count, so I learn the list changed without hunting for it

stories.capability: re-send an outstanding request from the queue without opening the profile
stories.benefit: chasing a blocked dependency costs one action instead of a context switch

acceptance_criteria.given: an input has been outstanding for 26 hours
acceptance_criteria.when: I chase it from the outstanding-input panel
acceptance_criteria.then: the request is re-sent, the item is stamped with the new time and moves to awaiting, and I stay on the queue

acceptance_criteria.given: I re-sent the same request 40 minutes ago
acceptance_criteria.then: the chase control is disabled and states when it was last sent, rather than being silently inert

stories.capability: search a target name and see every prior contact this firm has had with it, its sponsors and its subsidiaries
stories.benefit: I stop re-underwriting a company the firm has already met

acceptance_criteria.given: the London private equity desk met this borrower's CFO in 2024
acceptance_criteria.then: that meeting appears on the precedent timeline with its desk, date and the debt constraints noted at the time

acceptance_criteria.given: no repository holds any prior contact
acceptance_criteria.then: I am told plainly that all five repositories were searched, which they were and when each was last indexed, so an absence reads as a finding rather than a failure

acceptance_criteria.given: the mailbox index has not refreshed for longer than its freshness threshold
acceptance_criteria.then: a coverage indicator declares that source stale rather than presenting its results as current

accessibility_criteria.given: I use a screen reader and search a target name
accessibility_criteria.when: one repository responds and another is still searching
accessibility_criteria.then: each completion is announced politely with its source and match count, and an unreachable repository is announced assertively, because a missing source changes what the result set means

stories.capability: see that a precedent record exists on another desk even when I may not read it
stories.benefit: I know the firm holds relevant knowledge and can request it, instead of concluding there is none

acceptance_criteria.given: a matching record belongs to a desk walled from mine
acceptance_criteria.then: the entry shows its desk and date but never its content, and offers to request access

acceptance_criteria.given: I request access to a walled record
acceptance_criteria.then: it is logged against the owning desk and I see its pending state, and no content is disclosed before it is granted

stories.capability: have covenant definitions, leverage ratios, the EBITDA definition and the amortisation schedule extracted from a credit agreement and shown beside the sentence they came from
stories.benefit: I reconcile figures instead of re-typing them, and nothing enters the model unreviewed

acceptance_criteria.given: I upload a 300-page credit agreement
acceptance_criteria.then: terms appear as they are found with per-page progress, rather than a single blocking wait, and each term shows its extraction confidence

acceptance_criteria.given: I select an extracted term
acceptance_criteria.then: it scrolls to and highlights the citing passage, showing the document, page and clause

acceptance_criteria.given: the agreement is a scanned image with no text layer
acceptance_criteria.then: I am told that specifically, and offered manual entry with source attachment still available, rather than being shown zero terms

accessibility_criteria.given: I review extracted terms with a screen reader
accessibility_criteria.when: a term is extracted below the commit confidence threshold
accessibility_criteria.then: the term and its confidence are announced together, and the low confidence is conveyed by text rather than by colour alone

analytics_events.trigger: the associate commits a reviewed extraction batch

stories.capability: be stopped from committing terms while two documents define the same term differently
stories.benefit: a conflict is resolved deliberately instead of the first value silently winning

acceptance_criteria.given: two uploaded documents state different total leverage covenants
acceptance_criteria.then: commit is disabled and names the number of unresolved conflicts, and each conflict shows both values with their sources

acceptance_criteria.given: I resolve a conflict by choosing one source
acceptance_criteria.then: only accepted rows are written, and each committed figure retains the source offset it came from

analytics_events.trigger: a commit is blocked by two documents defining one term differently

stories.capability: have the profile model populated from committed extractions rather than re-keyed from PDFs
stories.benefit: I reach the leverage math and the thesis while there is still time to think about them

acceptance_criteria.given: I have committed the extracted terms
acceptance_criteria.then: the key metrics band and the financial model are populated, and no figure required manual transcription

acceptance_criteria.given: a vendor feed fails during the build
acceptance_criteria.then: it renders as unavailable with the reason, the last known value and its date, and never as zero or an empty cell

analytics_events.trigger: a profile model is populated from committed extractions

stories.capability: be shown a challenge flag when an add-back described as one-time also appears in prior periods
stories.benefit: I answer the reviewer's objection before she raises it, instead of anticipating it through formatting

acceptance_criteria.given: a 5.0m consulting fee is added back as one-time and the same fee appears in the two prior years
acceptance_criteria.then: a challenge flag is raised on that add-back listing the prior occurrences as its evidence

acceptance_criteria.given: a vendor pull has not been adjusted for an acquisition that closed after the pull date
acceptance_criteria.then: a challenge flag names the acquisition and its date

acceptance_criteria.given: the borrower has no prior periods
acceptance_criteria.then: recurrence detection reports that it could not run, rather than reporting no recurring add-backs

analytics_events.trigger: a one-time add-back is flagged as recurring in prior periods

stories.capability: open the source of any figure in the profile without leaving the page
stories.benefit: a number is never something I have to take on trust

acceptance_criteria.given: I select a figure extracted from a document
acceptance_criteria.then: it shows the citing sentence in its surrounding paragraph with the document, page and clause, and a link that opens the agreement at that position

acceptance_criteria.given: I select a figure that came from a vendor feed rather than a document
acceptance_criteria.then: it names the feed and the timestamp of the pull instead of a sentence

acceptance_criteria.given: a figure's source cannot be resolved
acceptance_criteria.then: the popover states that the source could not be located, visibly distinct from a popover that is still loading

accessibility_criteria.given: I open a figure's provenance with a keyboard
accessibility_criteria.then: focus moves into it, Escape closes it and returns focus to the figure I opened it from, and the popover's target area is at least 44x44px

analytics_events.trigger: a figure's source is opened from the profile

stories.capability: see the corporate structure and guarantee package derived from the agreements rather than drawn by hand
stories.benefit: I can establish who is on the hook for the debt in the first minutes of a review

acceptance_criteria.given: the agreement set establishes a parent, an issuer, two co-issuers and a non-guarantor subsidiary
acceptance_criteria.then: each entity shows its role, jurisdiction and guarantee position, with unrated offshore subsidiaries marked by label and shape, not colour alone

acceptance_criteria.given: one branch cannot be derived from the available documents
acceptance_criteria.then: that branch is shown explicitly as unverified rather than omitted, and confirm is disabled while it remains so

acceptance_criteria.given: no structural clauses are found in any document
acceptance_criteria.then: I am told which documents were searched and offered manual construction, rather than shown an empty canvas implying a flat structure

accessibility_criteria.given: I read the corporate structure with a screen reader
accessibility_criteria.then: the accessible tree conveys the same parent/subsidiary relationships as the canvas, and unresolved branches are announced as unverified rather than omitted

analytics_events.trigger: a corporate structure is derived from the agreements

stories.capability: have the review open on total leverage, then liquidity runway, then the guarantee package, in that order
stories.benefit: my review starts where I always start instead of where the document happens to begin

acceptance_criteria.given: a profile has been submitted
acceptance_criteria.then: the first-read band presents those three in that order, and the company overview is collapsed at the bottom

acceptance_criteria.given: the full model is still loading
acceptance_criteria.then: I can begin reading and verifying while the rest arrives

accessibility_criteria.given: I open a risk review with a screen reader
accessibility_criteria.when: the first-read band finishes loading before the rest of the model
accessibility_criteria.then: it announces that it is ready to read, and each figure states its verification status as text, never by colour alone

analytics_events.trigger: the reviewer opens a risk review

stories.capability: return a defect as a thread on the figure it concerns
stories.benefit: a correction never becomes a round of email, and a small fix I absorb myself stops being invisible

acceptance_criteria.given: I find that the leverage math is wrong
acceptance_criteria.when: I post a blocking thread on that figure
acceptance_criteria.then: the associate sees it against the figure rather than as a message, and the profile records it as blocking

acceptance_criteria.given: I fix a minor formatting defect myself
acceptance_criteria.then: it is recorded as a reviewer edit with the associate's original still visible, so the rework is visible rather than absorbed silently

analytics_events.trigger: a defect thread is opened on a figure

stories.capability: be prevented from signing off while a first-read figure cannot be verified
stories.benefit: my signature never sits behind a number whose source is broken

acceptance_criteria.given: a figure in the first-read band has an unresolvable source
acceptance_criteria.then: sign-off is disabled, the control names the specific blocker, and the reason is available to assistive technology rather than only visible

acceptance_criteria.given: every blocking thread is resolved and every first-read source resolves
acceptance_criteria.then: the sign-off is recorded against me individually with a timestamp, the associate is notified, and the committee packet is marked ready

analytics_events.trigger: sign-off is prevented by an unverifiable first-read figure

stories.capability: see at most five positions that need me today, each stating what changed, our exposure and the distance to breach
stories.benefit: I am told what to do about a position rather than shown fifty things that are true about it

acceptance_criteria.given: more than five positions deviate from their benchmark
acceptance_criteria.then: exactly five appear, ranked, and a sixth displaces the weakest rather than lengthening the list

acceptance_criteria.given: a position's transit times have risen 14% and it sits 0.30x from its covenant
acceptance_criteria.then: the item carries the change, the direct exposure figure and the distance to the threshold in one sentence

acceptance_criteria.given: nothing is outside tolerance
acceptance_criteria.then: I am told that explicitly, with the number of positions monitored and when signals last refreshed, so silence is distinguishable from a system that is not running

accessibility_criteria.given: I use a screen reader on the portfolio watch
accessibility_criteria.then: its item count and the computation time of the scores are announced politely, so I am never left believing a stale score is current

stories.capability: never be shown a health score computed from stale feeds as though it were current
stories.benefit: I do not act on a number that stopped being true days ago

acceptance_criteria.given: the scoring pipeline is unavailable
acceptance_criteria.then: the last computed scores render with their computation time stated and a persistent banner that they are not current

acceptance_criteria.given: a signal feed has stopped updating
acceptance_criteria.then: that position's score confidence is degraded rather than the score being frozen at its last value

acceptance_criteria.given: a position was booked before the platform existed and has no extracted covenant threshold
acceptance_criteria.then: it reports as not measurable, never as comfortable headroom

stories.capability: open the clause that defines the covenant a distance-to-breach was measured against
stories.benefit: I can check the definition behind the number instead of trusting the calculation

acceptance_criteria.given: a position is 0.30x from its total leverage covenant
acceptance_criteria.then: the clause extracted at underwriting opens, showing the sentence, the document and the page

acceptance_criteria.given: the covenant was amended after booking
acceptance_criteria.then: the amended threshold is shown and the change is marked, rather than the original standing silently

acceptance_criteria.given: the source clause cannot be resolved
acceptance_criteria.then: the threshold is still shown and explicitly marked as unsourced, because withholding it would be worse than showing it unverified

accessibility_criteria.given: I open a covenant clause with a keyboard from the position detail
accessibility_criteria.when: the clause opens and I dismiss it
accessibility_criteria.then: focus moves to the clause and returns to the covenant row on dismiss, and a covenant with no extracted threshold is announced as not measurable with its reason rather than passing silently

stories.capability: acknowledge a signal or escalate it to workout review, with either recorded
stories.benefit: seeing a problem and acting on it are distinguishable afterwards

acceptance_criteria.given: I have read an attention item
acceptance_criteria.then: the acknowledgement is timestamped against me, the item moves to recently acknowledged, and the signal and its reason are retained rather than deleted

acceptance_criteria.given: an acknowledged position deteriorates further
acceptance_criteria.then: it returns to the attention band rather than remaining acknowledged

acceptance_criteria.given: I do not hold workout authority
acceptance_criteria.then: it is disabled and names the role required, rather than being hidden

empty_states.01 - Screening Queue: No profiles assigned to you. Start a new profile to begin.
empty_states.02 - Precedent Search: No prior contact found. All five repositories were searched — CRM, credit documents, SharePoint, shared drives and mailboxes. Widen the search to sponsor and subsidiary names.
empty_states.03 - Document Extraction: No terms extracted. This usually means a scanned document with no text layer. You can enter terms manually and still attach the source passage.
empty_states.04 - Borrower Profile: Nothing committed yet. Upload a credit agreement to populate the model.
empty_states.05 - Corporate Structure: No structure could be derived from the documents searched. Upload the guarantee and security deed.
empty_states.06 - Risk Review: No challenge flags and no open threads. Add-back recurrence, pro-forma adjustment and source resolution were all checked and passed.
empty_states.07 - Portfolio Watch: Nothing needs your attention today. 40 positions monitored, signals refreshed 14 minutes ago.
empty_states.08 - Position Detail: This position is within tolerance on every covenant. Last checked 14 minutes ago.

error_states.01 - Screening Queue: The queue could not load. Your filter has been kept — try again.
error_states.02 - Precedent Search: One repository did not respond. These results are incomplete, and the missing source is named above.
error_states.03 - Document Extraction: Extraction is unavailable. Your uploaded documents have been kept — nothing has been lost.
error_states.04 - Borrower Profile: This figure is unavailable because its feed failed. The last known value and its date are shown instead.
error_states.05 - Corporate Structure: One branch could not be derived. It is marked unverified rather than left out.
error_states.06 - Risk Review: This figure's source could not be resolved, so it cannot be verified. Sign-off is blocked while it sits in the first read.
error_states.07 - Portfolio Watch: Scores are not current. The scoring pipeline is unavailable; these were computed at 06:12 today.
error_states.08 - Position Detail: No covenant threshold was extracted for this position, so headroom is not measurable. It is not zero, and it is not comfortable.

confirmations.01 - Screening Queue: Request re-sent. The item is now awaiting a reply.
confirmations.02 - Precedent Search: 4 precedent entries attached to the profile.
confirmations.03 - Document Extraction: 12 terms committed. The model has been populated.
confirmations.04 - Borrower Profile: Submitted for review. The assigned reviewer has been notified.
confirmations.05 - Corporate Structure: Structure confirmed. Your sign-off on the guarantee package is recorded.
confirmations.06 - Risk Review: Signed off. The committee packet is marked ready.
confirmations.07 - Portfolio Watch: Acknowledged. The signal and its reason have been kept.
confirmations.08 - Position Detail: Escalated to workout review. The credit team has been notified.
